issue.title: Prevent static generation bailout when draft mode is enabled

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Linking and Navigating
labels.description: Related to Next.js linking (e.g., <Link>) and navigation.

issue.body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
      Platform: linux
      Arch: x64
      Version: #22 SMP Tue Jan 10 18:39:00 UTC 2023
    Binaries:
      Node: 16.17.0
      npm: 8.15.0
      Yarn: 1.22.19
      pnpm: 7.1.0
    Relevant packages:
      next: 13.4.6-canary.2
      eslint-config-next: N/A
      react: 18.2.0
      react-dom: 18.2.0
      typescript: N/A
```


### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

App directory (appDir: true), Routing (next/router, next/navigation, next/link)

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue or a replay of the bug

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/nextjs-app-router-draft-cookie-bailout-7lhf2c

### To Reproduce

Use `cookies()` in any route with `dynamic` set to `error` or `force-static`.

### Describe the Bug

The new Draft Mode does not include a mechanism for passing data (e.g. preview tokens from a CMS) to the page component and underlying requests.

The logical approach is to use `cookies()` to set the preview data and then use this when in draft mode, which bypasses the static cache. Frustratingly, doing so triggers the static generation bailout.

### Extra context
- Unless I’m mistaken, Draft Mode is currently incompatible with Craft CMS as a result
- Similar/related to #49373.

### Expected Behavior

When the Draft Mode bypass cookie is set, the route should behave as is `dynamic` is set to `force-dynamic`, which would include enabling `cookies()`.

### Possible solution

I suspect adjusting [the bailout](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/a3344ad6fc1f47190ce31ae056959a7f7d272dac/packages/next/src/client/components/static-generation-bailout.ts) would be sufficient to rectify this.
